title: Man Standing on Outdoor Steps, 1964 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot stamped 'APR 64' along the top edge, featuring a man standing atop a wide concrete staircase. He wears a button-down white shirt with rolled sleeves and dark trousers, leaning lightly on a wooden stair handrail. The setting features mid-century Mediterranean/Spanish-style architectural elements including a clay tile roofed entryway and terraced stone retaining walls.
